theme.en: AI Demand Tightens Every Layer of Silicon
theme.zh: AI需求收紧硅产业每一层

dek.en: Capital, capacity, and component costs are all moving together as AI infrastructure expands. Accelerator alliances now reach directly into foundry ramps, memory pricing, and the optics that gate EUV output.
dek.zh: 随着AI基础设施扩张，资本、产能与零部件成本正在同步变化。加速器联盟的影响已直接延伸至晶圆代工爬坡、存储定价，以及制约EUV产出的光学系统。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia Plans $1 Billion Naver Investment for a 4.5% Stake
title.zh: Nvidia拟斥资10亿美元收购Naver 4.5%股权

summary.en: Nvidia plans to invest $1 billion in Naver for a 4.5% stake, according to KED Global, deepening the companies' AI-factory alliance. The transaction would make Nvidia a capital partner as well as a hardware supplier and give Naver additional funding for infrastructure deployment.
summary.zh: 据KED Global报道，Nvidia计划向Naver投资10亿美元并取得4.5%股权，进一步加深双方的AI工厂合作。若交易完成，Nvidia将从硬件供应商延伸为资本伙伴，Naver也将获得更多基础设施部署资金。

title.en: Qualcomm Plans Double-Digit Price Increases
title.zh: Qualcomm计划实施两位数幅度涨价

summary.en: Qualcomm plans to raise prices by a double-digit percentage, the Taipei Times reports. The increase would push higher silicon costs into handset makers' bills of materials and sharpen negotiations over premium mobile platforms.
summary.zh: 据《Taipei Times》报道，Qualcomm计划实施两位数百分比的价格上调。此举将把更高的芯片成本传导至手机厂商的物料清单，并加剧高端移动平台的采购谈判。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC's 2nm Ramp Reaches 20,000 Wafers a Month at One Fab
title.zh: 台积电单座晶圆厂2nm月产能升至2万片

summary.en: One TSMC plant has reportedly reached 20,000 2nm wafers per month as the foundry prepares initial shipments, with five Taiwan fabs focused on the node. The figure signals a meaningful ramp in wafer capacity—not finished-chip output—while AI customers are expected to account for much of later demand.
summary.zh: 报道称，台积电一座晶圆厂的2nm月产能已达到2万片，公司正准备首批出货，台湾共有5座晶圆厂聚焦该制程。这个数字反映的是晶圆产能而非成品芯片产量；后续需求预计将主要由AI客户推动。

title.en: Mitsui Fudosan Plans Physical-AI Hub Near TSMC's Kumamoto Base
title.zh: 三井不动产拟在台积电熊本基地附近建设Physical AI枢纽

summary.en: Mitsui Fudosan plans to build a physical-AI hub near TSMC's Kumamoto manufacturing base, Nikkei Asia reports. The project would extend the local cluster beyond wafer production toward robotics and embodied-AI development, broadening the economic spillover from the fab.
summary.zh: 据《Nikkei Asia》报道，三井不动产计划在台积电熊本制造基地附近建设Physical AI枢纽。该项目将当地产业集群从晶圆生产延伸至机器人与具身AI开发，扩大晶圆厂带来的区域经济外溢效应。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: GDDR6 and GDDR7 Shortages Push China GPU Prices Higher
title.zh: GDDR6与GDDR7短缺推高中国显卡价格

summary.en: Prices for Nvidia and AMD graphics cards have risen sharply in China as shops stockpile inventory amid GDDR6 and GDDR7 shortages. Wccftech says the cost of those DRAM products has increased as much as tenfold, showing how memory scarcity is reaching end-market GPU pricing.
summary.zh: 随着门店在GDDR6与GDDR7短缺背景下囤积库存，Nvidia和AMD显卡在中国市场的价格大幅上涨。Wccftech称相关DRAM产品成本最高已上涨10倍，显示存储稀缺正向终端GPU价格传导。

title.en: CXMT-Based DRAM Modules Match Big-Three Pricing in China
title.zh: 采用CXMT颗粒的DRAM模组在中国售价接近三大厂产品

summary.en: New Chinese retail listings show CXMT-based memory modules priced similarly to products using DRAM from Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron. The listings suggest that domestic supply is not yet creating the budget tier some buyers expected, limiting immediate price pressure on the incumbent vendors.
summary.zh: 中国市场的新零售报价显示，采用CXMT颗粒的内存模组与使用Samsung、SK hynix和Micron DRAM的产品价格相近。这表明国产供给尚未形成部分买家期待的低价层级，对三大存储厂商的即时价格压力有限。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Zeiss Adds 25,000 Square Meters at Its EUV Optics Site
title.zh: Zeiss为EUV光学基地新增2.5万平方米空间

summary.en: Zeiss is adding about 25,000 square meters of production and adjacent space at its Oberkochen site in Germany, where the first new building has opened four years after groundbreaking. Because Zeiss optics constrain ASML's EUV scanner output, the expansion targets one of the least substitutable links in advanced-node capacity.
summary.zh: Zeiss正在德国Oberkochen基地新增约2.5万平方米的生产及配套空间，首座新建筑在开工4年后投入使用。由于Zeiss光学系统制约ASML的EUV光刻机产量，此次扩建瞄准先进制程产能中最难替代的环节之一。

title.en: V-GaN Tech Hub Opens a Lab-to-Fab Test Facility
title.zh: V-GaN Tech Hub启用从实验室走向量产的测试设施

summary.en: The V-GaN Tech Hub has opened a test facility intended to move microelectronics projects from laboratory work toward fabrication. Shared testing infrastructure can shorten qualification cycles and lower the equipment barrier for GaN and related device teams before they commit to production.
summary.zh: V-GaN Tech Hub启用了一座测试设施，旨在推动微电子项目从实验室阶段走向制造。共享测试基础设施可在GaN及相关器件团队投入量产前缩短验证周期，并降低设备门槛。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: White House Accuses Moonshot AI of Evading Nvidia Export Controls
title.zh: 白宫指控Moonshot AI规避Nvidia芯片出口管制

summary.en: The White House has accused Moonshot AI of evading U.S. export controls on Nvidia chips in connection with the Kimi K3 model, according to Times Tabloid. The allegation, which remains a government claim rather than a demonstrated violation in the supplied report, raises scrutiny of chip provenance and enforcement across third-country supply routes.
summary.zh: 据Times Tabloid报道，白宫指控Moonshot AI在Kimi K3模型相关业务中规避美国对Nvidia芯片的出口管制。该说法目前仍是政府指控，所给报道并未证明违规事实，但它将加大对芯片来源及第三国供应路径执法的审查。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: ASML Revenue Forecast Rises 16% on AI-Chip Demand
title.zh: AI芯片需求推动ASML营收预测上调16%

summary.en: ASML's revenue forecast has increased 16% as demand for AI-chip manufacturing equipment runs ahead of prior expectations, AD HOC NEWS reports. The revision points to firmer tool demand beyond chip designers themselves, although the candidate report does not specify the forecast period.
summary.zh: 据AD HOC NEWS报道，受AI芯片制造设备需求高于此前预期推动，ASML营收预测上调16%。这一调整显示设备需求进一步走强，但候选报道未注明该预测对应的具体期间。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Korean AI Chips Enter Tests as Global Startups Target the Market
title.zh: 韩国AI芯片进入测试，全球初创公司加码当地市场

summary.en: Korean AI chips are entering evaluation as global accelerator startups step up their push into South Korea, Digital Today reports. The tests matter because deployment evidence—not launch claims—will determine whether challengers can displace incumbent GPU platforms in a concentrated data-center market.
summary.zh: 据Digital Today报道，随着全球加速器初创公司加码韩国市场，韩国AI芯片正进入评测阶段。这些测试的重要性在于，真正决定新势力能否在集中度较高的数据中心市场替代主流GPU平台的是部署证据，而非发布会上的性能宣称。

theme.en: Memory Hierarchies Move Into the Algorithm
theme.zh: 内存层级走进算法设计

dek.en: This week's work treats data movement as a first-class design variable, from hierarchical KV compression and CXL-backed reuse to in-NAND search and photonic interposers. At the same time, EDA-agent benchmarks show that reliable tool interaction remains harder than generating isolated blocks of RTL.
dek.zh: 本周研究将数据搬运视为首要设计变量，覆盖分层KV压缩、CXL支持的缓存复用、NAND内搜索与光子中介层。同时，EDA智能体基准表明，可靠地操作工具链仍比生成孤立RTL模块更难。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Leveraging ECRAM for Edge Continual Learning
title.zh: 利用ECRAM实现边缘端持续学习

papers.authors: N. Tasnim, H. Liu, Q. Cao, et al.

summary.en: CLASP combines ECRAM-based in-memory computing with an end-to-end system for continual learning at the edge, targeting both analog computation noise and the weak training support of prior IMC designs. Moving weight updates closer to memory could reduce the CPU/GPU data movement that makes on-device adaptation expensive. The preprint record supplies no measured-chip result, so the manufacturability and endurance case still needs device-level validation.
summary.zh: CLASP将基于ECRAM的存内计算与端到端边缘持续学习系统结合，同时处理模拟计算噪声与既有IMC设计训练支持不足的问题。把权重更新移近存储器，有望减少端侧自适应中昂贵的CPU/GPU数据搬运。该预印本记录未提供实测芯片结果，制造可行性与耐久性仍需器件级验证。

title.en: Circuits, Architecture & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、架构与可靠性

title.en: DGNA Maps GPU NUMA Behavior Through Microbenchmarks
title.zh: DGNA通过微基准解析GPU NUMA行为

papers.authors: C. Liu, Y. Chen, T. E. Carlson

summary.en: DGNA measures L2-cache and DRAM latency without architecture-specific intrinsic instructions, then uses a Gaussian mixture model to separate latency distributions from outliers. The authors apply the method to Nvidia A100 and H100 GPUs, offering software and simulator designers a way to infer otherwise undocumented NUMA behavior. These are reverse-engineered microbenchmark results, not vendor-confirmed topology.
summary.zh: DGNA无需依赖特定架构的内建指令即可测量L2缓存与DRAM延迟，并使用高斯混合模型从异常值中分离延迟分布。作者将该方法用于Nvidia A100与H100 GPU，为软件和模拟器设计者推断未公开的NUMA行为提供路径。这些结论来自逆向微基准，并非厂商确认的拓扑。

title.en: From Known Good Die to Reliability-Aware Chiplet Screening
title.zh: 从已知良品裸片走向可靠性感知的chiplet筛选

summary.en: This work recasts chiplet screening as a Bayesian inference problem that maps pre-assembly telemetry to post-assembly failure risk, with safety gates and uncertainty-aware disposition boundaries. The framework addresses a real gap: a functionally good die is not automatically a die with a quantified lifetime guarantee after packaging. Validation uses Monte Carlo data from 4,000 synthetic dies, so fab telemetry and field failures are still needed to test calibration.
summary.zh: 该研究把chiplet筛选重构为贝叶斯推断问题，将封装前遥测数据映射为封装后失效风险，并加入安全门控与不确定性感知的处置边界。它直指一个现实缺口：功能合格的裸片并不自动具备封装后的量化寿命保证。验证仅使用4,000颗合成裸片的蒙特卡洛数据，仍需晶圆厂遥测与现场失效数据检验其校准能力。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: HEMERA Streams Mamba-2 Without Quadratic Intermediate Storage
title.zh: HEMERA以流式执行消除Mamba-2二次方中间存储

papers.authors: H. Ding, L. Liang, R. Qiao, et al.

summary.en: HEMERA algebraically reformulates Mamba-2's matrix-form state-space duality into a streaming-recursive dataflow that avoids quadratic intermediate materialization. A heterogeneous memory-centric accelerator then maps state propagation and matrix work onto different execution resources, directly targeting edge bandwidth limits. The supplied preprint record does not include complete benchmark or measured-silicon figures, so the claimed system advantage remains to be quantified independently.
summary.zh: HEMERA把Mamba-2矩阵形式的状态空间对偶计算代数重构为流式递归数据流，从而避免二次方规模的中间结果物化。异构内存中心加速器再将状态传播与矩阵运算映射到不同执行资源，直接瞄准边缘设备的带宽限制。所给预印本记录未包含完整基准或实测芯片数据，其系统优势仍需独立量化。

title.en: PHONON Co-Designs a Photonic Interposer Network for LLM Chiplets
title.zh: PHONON为LLM chiplet协同设计光子中介层网络

papers.authors: G. Narang, A. R. Bommana, K. Chakrabarty
papers.venue: ACM Transactions on Design Automation of Electronic Systems

summary.en: PHONON jointly optimizes compute-to-compute and compute-to-storage traffic in a silicon-photonic network on an interposer for multi-chiplet LLM inference. Structured waveguide placement, cluster-level storage connectivity, and kernel mapping aim to reduce crossings, propagation loss, and long multi-hop transfers. The paper targets a credible packaging bottleneck, but the supplied record does not show a fabricated photonic interposer, so its gains should be read as architectural evidence.
summary.zh: PHONON面向多chiplet LLM推理，在硅光中介层网络中协同优化计算到计算与计算到存储的流量。其结构化波导布局、簇级存储连接和计算核映射旨在减少交叉、传播损耗及长距离多跳传输。论文瞄准了可信的封装瓶颈，但所给记录未显示已制造的光子中介层，因此相关收益应视为架构层证据。

title.en: D-NOVA Pushes RAG Similarity Search Into 3D NAND
title.zh: D-NOVA将RAG相似度搜索推进3D NAND内部

papers.authors: C. E. Song, S. Pinge, T. Zhang, et al.

summary.en: D-NOVA embeds an IVF-based retrieval pipeline into the 3D NAND array using a NAND-tailored dual-bound similarity metric and a lightweight vector adapter. The design attacks the nearly 70% of retrieval time that the paper attributes to processors outside storage, potentially reducing movement in RAG serving. The candidate record does not provide measured-array results, leaving sensing margins, endurance, and recall under device variation as open questions.
summary.zh: D-NOVA利用面向NAND的双界相似度指标与轻量向量适配器，把基于IVF的检索流程嵌入3D NAND阵列。该设计针对论文所称近70%的检索时间消耗在存储器外处理器上的问题，有望减少RAG服务中的数据搬运。候选记录未提供阵列实测结果，感测裕量、耐久性及器件波动下的召回率仍是开放问题。

title.en: Hardware-Relevant AI Research
title.zh: 硬件相关AI研究

title.en: HiKV Compresses KV Cache at Token and Element Granularity
title.zh: HiKV在Token与元素两级压缩KV Cache

papers.authors: C. Fang, J. Yin, M. Shi, et al.

summary.en: HiKV first evicts low-importance tokens and then loads only significant elements within retained tokens, with one reconfigurable sorter accelerating both stages. Across representative LLMs, the authors report up to 7.95x attention speedup, 90% lower energy, and no more than 1% accuracy loss; at equal accuracy, external-memory accesses fall another 1.82–4.87x versus prior importance-based methods. The results are from a preprint and still need independent reproduction on deployed hardware.
summary.zh: HiKV先淘汰低重要性Token，再仅加载保留Token中的关键元素，并用一个可重构排序器加速两个阶段。作者在代表性LLM上报告最高7.95倍注意力加速、90%能耗降低且精度损失不超过1%；在等精度条件下，外部内存访问较既有重要性感知方法进一步减少1.82至4.87倍。该结果来自预印本，仍需在实际部署硬件上独立复现。

title.en: BaseRT Exploits Apple M5 Neural Accelerators for Local LLMs
title.zh: BaseRT利用Apple M5 Neural Accelerators加速本地LLM

papers.authors: F. Waschkowski, P. Rathnayaka, L. Wesemann

summary.en: BaseRT adds hand-written Metal 4 kernels for dense and MoE GEMM plus flash-attention prefill, routing compute-bound work through the M5's per-core Neural Accelerators while retaining specialized decode kernels. On an M5 Pro across 15 model configurations up to 35B parameters, it reports as much as 6.4x higher prompt throughput than llama.cpp, 3.9x over MLX, and up to 1.75x faster decode than llama.cpp. The comparison is platform-specific, and broader reproducibility will depend on public code and matched quantization settings.
summary.zh: BaseRT为稠密与MoE GEMM以及Flash Attention预填充加入手写Metal 4内核，把计算受限任务送入M5每个核心的Neural Accelerator，同时保留专用解码内核。在M5 Pro上测试15种、最高35B参数的模型配置后，论文报告提示词处理吞吐最高为llama.cpp的6.4倍、MLX的3.9倍，解码速度最高比llama.cpp快1.75倍。该比较高度依赖平台，更广泛的可复现性取决于公开代码与一致的量化设置。

title.en: HyMCache Uses CXL Hybrid Memory for Reusable KV State
title.zh: HyMCache以CXL混合内存承载可复用KV状态

papers.authors: H. Jang, I. Song, S. H. Noh, et al.

summary.en: HyMCache combines a small in-device DRAM tier with SSD-backed capacity behind CXL to store reusable KV state for long-context, multi-turn serving. Request-level prefix prefetching and opportunistic write buffering exploit the cache's predictable, read-heavy, append-only behavior, aiming for TB-scale capacity at SSD cost. Evaluation uses a real CXL-hybrid-memory prototype, but the supplied record omits the final comparative numbers, so latency under larger shared workloads remains the key result to inspect.
summary.zh: HyMCache把少量设备内DRAM与CXL接口后的SSD容量结合，用于存储长上下文、多轮服务中可复用的KV状态。请求级前缀预取与机会式写缓冲利用KV Cache可预测、读密集和仅追加的访问特征，目标是在SSD成本下提供TB级容量。评估使用真实CXL混合内存原型，但所给记录缺少最终对比数字，因此更大规模共享负载下的延迟仍是最值得核查的结果。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: Benchmarking AI Agents on End-to-End RTL-to-GDS
title.zh: 端到端RTL-to-GDS流程中的AI智能体基准

papers.authors: J. Deng, Z. Chen, X. Wei, et al.

summary.en: This benchmark runs three agent architectures and four foundation models through a PicoRV32 RTL-to-GDS flow with commercial EDA tools under two timing targets. Domain skills improve individual subtasks but do not ensure end-to-end completion, while agents reaching similar design progress differ by as much as 141x in Token ROI. Tool-interface mismatches, especially during physical design, remain a larger reliability problem than isolated RTL generation.
summary.zh: 该基准让3种智能体架构与4个基础模型在两档时序目标下，使用商业EDA工具完成PicoRV32的RTL-to-GDS流程。领域技能能改善单项任务，却无法保证端到端完成；设计进度相近的智能体在Token ROI上最多相差141倍。工具接口不匹配，尤其是物理设计阶段的问题，仍比孤立的RTL生成更影响可靠性。
